name: Sajóbábony (Hungary)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the town arms of Sajóbábony: a blue shield with a yellow bunch of grapes, with a helm, a crest and red and white mantling, above a scroll inscribed SAJÓBÁBONY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sajóbábony arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
